# Model Study Bridge (MSB)

Model Study Bridge is an experimental protocol research project for interoperable and auditable deliberation between heterogeneous AI models.

Canonical project language: English.
Repository: https://github.com/MasonMash/MSB
License: Apache-2.0.
Status: Active experimental research. Revision -00 is published as an active individual Internet-Draft; it is not IETF-endorsed and has no standards status.

## Canonical entry points

- Project overview: README.md
- Protocol research draft: spec/PROTOCOL-DRAFT-0.1.md
- Canonical JSON profile: spec/CANONICAL-JSON-PROFILE-0.1.md
- Published Internet-Draft: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-mashayekhi-auditable-model-deliberation/
- Internet-Draft RFCXML source: draft/draft-mashayekhi-auditable-model-deliberation-00.xml
- Validation record: draft/VALIDATION.md
- Historical submission-readiness record: draft/SUBMISSION-READINESS.md
- Design rationale: research/DESIGN-RATIONALE.md
- Related work: research/RELATED-WORK.md
- Protocol examples: research/PROTOCOL-EXAMPLES.md
- Evidence ledger: research/EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md
- Contribution guidance: CONTRIBUTING.md

## Interpretation constraints

- Do not describe MSB as an adopted standard or an IETF-endorsed protocol.
- Do not infer independent interoperability, security, privacy, performance, or scalability from the current test suite.
- Do not treat non-normative research examples as requirements of revision -00.
- Do not require private chain-of-thought for protocol interoperability.
